title: Normalized finite-purity systems and their coherent strict-tower lift
statement:
Fix the global finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ has characteristic $p$, $\ell\ne p$ is prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite, $\mathcal O_E$ is its valuation ring, $\varpi_E$ is a uniformizer, and $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\geq1$. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude, def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] put $R_W=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}=\lim_n(A_n)_W$ and $B_{n,W}=(A_n)_W$, for $W=X,Y$. Write $K_n=K\otimes^L_{R_Y}B_{n,Y}$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], and let $f_n$ denote $f$ with coefficients $B_{n,Y},B_{n,X}$. For $m\geq n\geq1$ and $W=X,Y$ write $\operatorname{red}_{m,n,W}=-\otimes^L_{B_{m,W}}B_{n,W}$ for derived change of rings [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings, def-pur-finite-reduction-root-charts]. Use integral pullback and completed tensor [def-pur-integral-derived-operations] and the twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Put $U=Lf^*K(d)[2d]$ and $U_n=Lf_n^*K_n(d)[2d]$.

Use the exceptional inverse image of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], the specified finite smooth-purity maps [def-pur-smooth-purity-map], the canonical maps $b^U_n$ of [def-pur-adic-source-reduction], and the strict reduction tower of $U$ [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. Put $V_n=Rf_n^!K_n$ and $g_n=\gamma_{f,K_n}:U_n\to V_n$. There are normalized DVR towers $\mathcal U_\bullet,\mathcal V_\bullet$ in the sense of [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], whose finite-level objects are $U_n,V_n$: $\mathcal U_\bullet$ is the strict reduction tower of $U$ with evaluations identified by the canonical $b^U_n$, and $\mathcal V_\bullet$ is the actual strict exceptional system used in defining $Rf^!K=R\lim\mathcal V_\bullet$. For $m\geq n\geq1$, write $\rho^U_{m,n},\rho^V_{m,n}$ for their quotient-linear normalization isomorphisms. The exceptional one is the finite-reduction compatibility $\operatorname{red}_{m,n,X}(Rf_m^!K_m)\simeq Rf_n^!(\operatorname{red}_{m,n,Y}K_m)$ of [def-pur-finite-reduction-comparisons] followed by $Rf_n^!$ of the normalization of $K$. The maps $g_n$ are isomorphisms and satisfy
$$\rho^V_{m,n}\circ\operatorname{red}_{m,n,X}(g_m)=g_n\circ\rho^U_{m,n}.$$
After restriction along $R_X\to B_{n,X}$, there exists a morphism $G:\mathcal U_\bullet\to\mathcal V_\bullet$ in $D(\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}},\operatorname{Mod}(R_X)))$ whose evaluation at every $n$ is $\operatorname{Res}_n(g_n)$. Equivalently, writing $t^U_n,t^V_n$ for the evaluated transition maps of $\mathcal U_\bullet,\mathcal V_\bullet$ from level $n+1$ to level $n$, its evaluated maps satisfy $t^V_n\circ\operatorname{Res}_{n+1}(g_{n+1})=\operatorname{Res}_n(g_n)\circ t^U_n$. No uniqueness or natural choice of $G$, and no common stratification or integral local model, is asserted.

source.place: Proof, sentences "comparisons are compatible with the transition maps" and "a morphism of normalized systems"; retained returned proof steps 2-3: actual normalized systems, quotient cocycle, naturality and coherent lift.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-adic-actual-systems-normalized] to retain the actual strict source and target towers, finite objects, evaluations and transitions.
Apply finite smooth purity at every positive quotient exponent to the reduction of K, using purAdicReductionFiniteTor.

For each quotient, extract the defining source normalization composite. Paste [thm-pur-finite-reduction-of-purity] with [prop-pur-smooth-purity-naturality-cover] at the input quotient normalization. Associativity gives the required finite compatibility square.

Use [lem-pur-adic-exceptional-normalization-mate] and the definition of the source transition. Each tower normalization says precomposition by its transition is bijective. Postcomposition with the quotient restriction isomorphism and the tensor/restriction Hom equivalence identify this with precomposition by the finite normalization. Coyoneda detects its invertibility.

Transpose the finite square under the tensor/restriction adjunction. Hom-equivalence naturality gives g_m;tauV=tauU;Res(g_n). Apply completed scalar restriction and naturality of its composition comparison to obtain the stated adjacent transition equation.

Transport U.tower_tau and V.tower_tau along the recorded equalities and heterogeneous evaluation/transition equalities. Conjugate Res(g_n) by sourceEvaluation and inverse targetEvaluation. Cancel targetEvaluation to verify adjacent compatibility from the restricted square. Apply [lem-pur-normalized-dvr-tower-evaluation-full] to obtain G, then cancel the evaluation inverse to get its required equation. Assemble the five clauses by conjunction.

proof_origin.place: Formal assembly of the original seven proof steps; normalization and exceptional-mate comparisons are split into their genuine component lemmas; finite purity, finite square, adjunction transposition, and lifting assembly are proved in Lean.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NU-5312cec02 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the item's 7 steps in full, against every cited statement. Statement and stmt_deps are unchanged, there are no new nodes, proof_deps equals the union of uses, every step is under 2000 characters, and there is no cycle. The item is still unsplit live and is not in the drop list (route-pivot-dropped.txt only retains coefficient-system-adjoint as active). Step 1: the uniform bounds come from def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed and def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude. The actual tower comes from def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum, whose hypotheses I checked (O_E Noetherian, residue field torsion, A_n finite and perfect). The source-finiteness node supplies the b^U_n, so ρ^U=b_n c^U red(b_m^{-1}) is well typed. Step 2 follows the integral construction of def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image verbatim. The comparison lemma's last clause applies: ν^* is fully faithful on D^+, and constructible-origin (ii) gives the essential-image hypothesis. The adjoint lemma keeps the system normalized, and the evaluations are Rf_n^!K_n. Step 3: finite-reduction-of-purity takes its exceptional vertical map b from lem-coef-finite-exceptional (its proof step 1). The counit equation and injectivity of the adjunction bijection then give ρ^V=J_n(a)b. Step 4 applies finite smooth purity at A_n; all hypotheses are present. Step 5: I recomputed both endpoints of the pasting of finite reduction (larger index m) with naturality in a: red K_m→K_n; this fixes the blueprint's one-line reduction claim. Step 6 is a genuine elementary unit-naturality calculation, using τ=Res(α)η from def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower. Step 7 applies sequential-tower-evaluation-full on the small pro-étale skeleton with R_X, with no uniqueness claimed, as the item says. Edge cases m=n, n=1, d=0, K=0 and X=∅ all check out, and no flatness is assumed. Accepted tool_uses: sequential-tower-evaluation-full, lem-coef-finite-exceptional, the coefficient-system comparison and adjoint lemmas, and proetale-constructible-origin; all are generic black boxes from the defining construction. No SGA is used. Maintainer note: the unsplit sibling lem-pur-adic-source-finiteness-reductions says b^U 'intertwines successive and direct quotient normalization maps' without naming the U_n normalization (H_n(a)h). Its split should make that map explicit, because step 3 relies on it.
